title: agent-budget-semantics: Differential Testing of Budget Enforcement Across AI Agent Frameworks
description: Differential testing of budget enforcement across 11 AI agent frameworks against a deterministic mock language model with a request ledger. Same underlying workload (four LLM calls, three tool calls, 478 tokens) produces four distinct gen_ai.agent.iteration_budget.consumed values across enforcing frameworks. Pre-run source-code readings agreed with runtime for exactly half of the executed frameworks. A synthetic per-iteration chargeback rate applied uniformly across the framework-reported counts diverges by up to 2.3x. One executed framework (Agno 1.2.5) accepts a tool_call_limit that its outer loop does not respect, producing runtime paths without framework-supplied bound. Findings support the OpenTelemetry semantic-conventions working group's proposal to record iteration_budget.limit verbatim without cross-framework normalization.
